text:
AIRPORT COLLABORATIVE DECISION MAKING (ACDM) CONNECTED WITH 
NETWORK MANAGEMENT OPERATIONS CENTRE. DEPARTURE PLANNING INFO 
MESSAGES WITH FLIGHT DATA WILL BE SENT TO OPERATIONAL NETWORK 
MANAGEMENT SYSTEM. FLIGHT CREWS ARE REQUIRED TO CONTACT ATC FOR 
DEPARTURE CLEARANCE WITHIN VALID TARGET OFF-BLOCKS TIME (TOBT) -5/+5 
MINS. WHEN THE FLIGHT IS READY OUTSIDE THE TOBT WINDOW, FLIGHT CREW 
SHALL CONTACT THE GROUND HANDLER BEFORE. PUSH AND/OR START-UP WILL 
BE ALLOCATED BASED ON TARGET START APPROVAL TIME (TSAT) +/-5 MINS.)
